products.title: Trailhead Insulated Bottle 24 oz
products.description: Double-wall vacuum insulated stainless steel bottle with a leak-proof flip lid.

specifications.insulation: Keeps drinks cold up to 24 hours and hot up to 12 hours
specifications.base_diameter: 2.9 in (74 mm) — fits most standard car cup holders

products.care: Lid is top-rack dishwasher safe. Hand-wash the bottle body; dishwashers can damage the vacuum seal.

products.title: Lumen Rechargeable Desk Lamp
products.description: Cordless LED desk lamp with three color temperatures and five brightness levels.

specifications.charging: USB-C; use an adapter rated 5V/2A or higher; full charge in about 4 hours

products.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Do not submerge or charge near water.
troubleshooting: Won't turn on: charge 2 hours with a 5V/2A USB-C adapter, then hold power 10 seconds to reset.
Flickering: normal below 10% battery; if plugged in, switch to a 5V/2A adapter; reset by holding power 10 seconds.
Still flickering when fully charged on a 5V/2A adapter: likely defective — return (30 days) or warranty claim (12 months).
Hot to the touch, swelling, burning smell: stop using immediately and escalate (safety).
